steps.name: Epilogue ~ Veiling the Black Moon
steps.objective: A visitor has come to see [Irfan] in 「Elysia 2」. Watch their conversation, then turn in the quest to [Irfan].

lines.text: (Irfan gazes absently at the sky over Elysia, then turns to his visitor.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Elysia went so long without visitors, and now look how busy it is... I can hardly imagine how many people came before Lady Hecate was imprisoned.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: And to think Lady Hecate summoned gods from other worlds while creating a place to test him.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Is that so? Here, have some tea.
(Daphne hands Irfan a cup of tea brewed from leaves.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Ah, the fragrance of Eastland. It takes me back to the days I spent soaking in the Azna Hot Springs, when I was alive...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I owe Lady Hecate my thanks, if only for letting me enjoy tea through my memories of life...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Is this the third time we have shared tea?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I am still grateful to you for saving that child of our clan. In those days, tea was all I could offer you. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The tea was good then, too. Does that still trouble you? You helped me as well. There is no need to dwell on it.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Now, tell me why you have come. I know you slipped into Elysia without Lady Hecate's knowledge.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: You knew?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: If you used power great enough to obscure the Black Moon to come here, this must matter a great deal to you.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I would like your help.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I have already repaid my debt to you.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Please help me just once more.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: And what would I gain from it?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I will give you a new life.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You sound like an Agasura.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: An Agasura loses their very self to their contract. I do not.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I ask you again. I can give you a full life, free of this incomplete existence bound to Elysia.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: How can I trust your word?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I will show you when the coming night arrives.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I will help, but I need no reward. I am content with my life here. Instead, help Lady Hecate when the time comes.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: We can consider that when the time comes. Now, I am listening. What is this favor?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I would like you to open Atlas Garden.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What did you just say?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: How do you know of Atlas Garden?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I thought someone so close to being a demigod as yourself could open the garden wide. It seems I was right. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: And what do you intend to do there?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Welcome back a child who pursues the night for a different purpose. It will benefit Lady Hecate...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Very well. Follow me. But this child... Did you bring her?

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Hello, hello! ☆

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Yes, I did. She will be helping me. I imagine she will be far more useful than the child who did nothing but run away.

lines.speaker: 키르케
lines.text: Daphne, Daphne! Is that garden a fun place?

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Of course. You will make a new friend, Circe.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: All that friend wants is smiles and love. Hehe...
